basic_info.description: 2315 Van Ness is a top-floor condominium in a boutique 8-unit building. The property features exceptional natural light and a large private roof deck with full span Golden Gate Bridge views. The residence includes two bedrooms and one and a half bathrooms across 980 square feet of living space. The home offers an open-plan living and dining area with views of Russian Hill, a gourmet kitchen with stainless steel appliances and bar seating, in-unit washer and dryer, two balconies, and built-in closets. This premier Cow Hollow location is a short distance from the vibrant restaurants, boutiques, and entertainment offered by Union and Polk Street. It's also within close proximity to Fort Mason, Aquatic Park Cove, & Marina Green.
